description: This Java source file defines a component class 'LocalstackS3ClientCustomizer' that customizes an AWS S3 client builder to override the endpoint URI when a specific environment property is set. It is used in the testing profile of the project to configure S3 interactions, likely for local testing with Localstack.

classes.name: LocalstackS3ClientCustomizer
classes.description: A Spring component that customizes the AWS S3 client builder for local testing environments by setting a custom endpoint URI if specified in environment variables.

methods.name: customize
methods.description: Overrides the S3ClientBuilder to set a custom endpoint URI if 'AWS_ENDPOINT_URL' environment property is set and not blank.
